- from a ruler of one country
- to another [ruler/country?]

- King Michael is ruler (King) of Romania.
- President US is leader of another country? It says President of US.
- Date? The memorandum dated March 5, 1945. Does it establish letter was written in first half 20th century? If before 1901? impossible if King Michael born 1921. But no outside. However the letter from King Michael likely 1945. C1 date of cover memo. Does "written in first half" fully supported?
